response.answer: This map does not include crime data, so I can't give a crime rate for 11226 (Brooklyn). It covers Census education and language measures, libraries, and schools only. Closest available measures for 11226: it is rated High Need, with an educational-need score of 76.7 (9 of 148 reliable ZIPs, where 1 is highest need). About 12% of residents (12,309 people) report Haitian ancestry, 14% of households have no internet, and 14% of adults 25+ lack a high school diploma. The ZIP has 8 libraries within 1 mile and 17 schools within 1 mile.
response.interpretation: Read the crime-rate question as a request for a metric the data does not contain; offered the ZIP's educational-need profile as the closest available measure.
assumptions: "High need" means the top third of reliable ZIPs in New York City by composite educational-need score (40% Haitian-ancestry share, 30% households without internet, 30% adults without a high school diploma): score ≥ 62.5 is high, 42.4–62.5 medium, below 42.4 low.
Library distances are straight-line miles from the nearest edge of each ZIP (a library inside the ZIP counts as 0 miles), not travel distance.
Figures are ACS 2022 5-year estimates, which carry margins of error.
